title: SZD - Simple Zombie Defense
description: Just base building and zombie defense, nothing special
body:
# SZD Modpack

**Minecraft 1.21.1 • NeoForge 21.1.219**

A modpack focused on base building and zombie defense with 7 Days to Die–style progression. Horde nights scale over time, but the difficulty stays manageable—no obsidian-breaking zombies or extreme late-game spikes.

---

## Features

- **Zombie defense:** Undead Nights with configurable horde nights, 5 difficulty tiers, and progressive mob types (horde zombies → elites → demolition → skeletons)
- **Combat:** TACZ (Timeless and Classics Zero) + Elite x Quality Guns for firearms
- **Base building:** SecurityCraft (cameras, reinforced blocks), Blocks You Need, Chipped, Sophisticated Backpacks & Storage
- **Farming:** Farmer's Delight with cooking and crops
- **Mining:** Veinminer (crouch to activate), Falling Tree for instant tree chopping
- **World gen:** Even Better Nether, YUNG's Better structures (caves, dungeons, strongholds, temples, etc.)
- **QoL:** JEI, Jade (WAILA-style), Xaero Minimap & World Map, Corpse (death inventory), AppleSkin, Inventory Profiles Next
- **Performance:** Sodium, Iris, Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, More Culling, ImmediatelyFast
- **Visuals:** Entity Texture/Model Features, ComplementaryReimagined shaders

---

## Key Bindings

| Action | Key |
|--------|-----|
| TACZ aim | Right Mouse |
| TACZ reload | R |
| TACZ inspect | H |
| Veinminer | V (hold crouch) |
| Xaero Minimap | M |
| Jade config | Numpad 0 |
| Corpse death history | U |
| Sophisticated Backpack | B |

---

## Configuration

Important settings already applied:

- **TACZ:** Explosive ammo does not destroy blocks (protects your base)
- **Undead Nights:** 5 difficulty levels, 5 hordes, dynamic scaling
- **Veinminer:** Crouch to activate, ore whitelist, 64 blocks max

---

## Shaderpack

**ComplementaryReimagined** (r5.7.1) — Profile: HIGH

---

## Resource Packs (Recommended Order)

1. FA+All_Extensions-v1.8.zip
2. FreshAnimations_v1.10.4.zip
3. §3Blue's §fBetter Zombies §7v0.13.zip
4. Blues_Better_Monsters_v0.10.zip
5. NewGlowingOres-§6[Border]§r.zip

Enable and order them in-game: Options → Resource Packs.

---

## Known Exclusions

- **Dynamic Surroundings** — Removed (Architectury compatibility crash on load)
- **TaCZ Pack Upgrader** — Removed after initial migration; pack is already in new format
